command: cd /app && ls logs | sed 's/_.*//' | sort -u | head -3; echo "--- max/min dates:"; ls logs | sed 's/_.*//' | sort -u | tail -3; echo "--- distinct bracket tokens:"; cat logs/*.log | grep -o '\[[A-Z]*\]' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- total lines:"; cat logs/*.log | wc -l; echo "--- files per date count:"; ls logs | sed 's/_.*//' | sort | uniq -c | tail -5; echo "--- line dates vs filename mismatches:"; for f in logs/*.log; do d=$(basename $f | cut -c1-10); awk -v d="$d" '{ if (substr($0,1,10)!=d) c++ } END { if (c>0) print FILENAME, c }' "$f"; done | head

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' > /app/make_summary.py
import csv, os, re
from datetime import date, timedelta

LOG_DIR = "/app/logs"
TODAY = date(2025, 8, 12)
SEVS = ["ERROR", "WARNING", "INFO"]

periods = [
    ("today", TODAY, TODAY),
    ("last_7_days", TODAY - timedelta(days=6), TODAY),
    ("last_30_days", TODAY - timedelta(days=29), TODAY),
    ("month_to_date", TODAY.replace(day=1), TODAY),
    ("total", date.min, date.max),
]

# counts[(period)] = dict sev -> count
counts = {p: {s: 0 for s in SEVS} for p, _, _ in periods}

fname_re = re.compile(r"^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_.*\.log$")
sev_re = re.compile(r"\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]")

for name in sorted(os.listdir(LOG_DIR)):
    m = fname_re.match(name)
    if not m:
        continue
    fdate = date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    with open(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, name), "r", errors="replace") as f:
        for line in f:
            sm = sev_re.search(line)
            if not sm:
                continue
            sev = sm.group(1)
            for p, start, end in periods:
                if start <= fdate <= end:
                    counts[p][sev] += 1

with open("/app/summary.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["period", "severity", "count"])
    for p, _, _ in periods:
        for s in SEVS:
            w.writerow([p, s, counts[p][s]])
print("written")
EOF
python3 /app/make_summary.py && echo "---" && cat /app/summary.csv
